chapter: Trombonists and bandleaders across the river
title: Playing with Remus Matthews, Bebe Matthews and Bill
summary: Valentine played with Remus under John Cassidy but never knew Bebe, a drummer who died before he came; Bill played with him in the country. The tape ends in garbled text.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh yeah. Hey boys. I was gonna ask you, did you ever play with the Matthews brothers, Bebe or Remus very much? You mentioned Bebe.
No, me and Remus played together with John Cassidy.
Yeah but Bebe I never played, I never knew him. Never knew him. No he died before I knew him. He was a great drummer, they told me. Great drummer huh.
Yeah, Bill didn't play with me too. Sure. Trombone or drums? Yeah. Sure Bill went country, different time with me in the country. Yeah. And playing time he used to tell me. D&P D&
